chunks: Al-Ḥasan ibn Maḥbūb narrated from ʿAlī ibn Riʾāb, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning
a man who mounted his servant upon an animal, and it trampled a man. He عليه السلام said: "The liability is upon its master."

key_terms.عَبْدَهُ: his servant or slave under his authority

ai.seo_question: Who is responsible for compensation if an animal tramples someone while being ridden by a servant?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about liability when an animal causes injury while being used under a master's authority through his servant. The Imam عليه السلام states that the financial compensation falls upon the master, indicating responsibility remains with the owner in such a case.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5349 - Al-Hasan ibn Mahbub narrated from Ali ibn Ri'ab, who narrated from Abu Abdullah Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) regarding

a man who placed his servant on an animal, and the animal trampled a man.
Imam (as) said: "The compensation is upon the master."
